caption: A serene beach scene unfolds as the sun sets on the horizon, casting a warm glow over two carefully balanced stone towers. Suddenly, the left tower begins to wobble, its topmost stone shifting precariously. With a gentle clatter, the stones tumble down, scattering across the smooth pebbles below. The sound of the stones hitting each other echoes softly, blending with the rhythmic crashing of the waves. The stones settle into a new, natural arrangement on the beach.
